title: Gideon and the Safehouse
author: Theo Villalobos
blurb: Wendell Winterbourne, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
